claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pramipexole is a dopamine receptor agonist that is not cytotoxic at 2.5 uM; it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak antiproliferative signal reflecting dopamine-receptor-mediated growth modulation rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
